text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinting Heroine Кинг Хало." "Will
she
conquer the Dual Sprints again next
year?" As
Кинг Хало soaks up the glory
of this breaking
news article, her cell
phone rings.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's Кинг Хало's mother, asking whether
her next
plans are to run another sprint
or a mile race.
Кинг Хало's answer—the
autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Taken aback by her daughter's apparent
caprice,
Кинг Хало's mother tells her to
make sure she
wins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But, at least this time, she doesn't tell
Кинг Хало
to come home. Her reply
sounds aimed at a
professional
Umamusume. I watch as Кинг Хало
smiles
over the change in tone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
